fields.name: test qual
Data Management and Visualisation
fields.description: Starter qualification record. Rename this if your official qualification title differs.

fields.name: Test Module
Advanced Power BI
fields.description: Power BI module containing five progressive assignments covering Power Query, modelling, DAX, reporting, and Power BI Service.

fields.title: Data Integration and Transformation Using Power Query
fields.skill_statement: Prepare and transform raw data into analysis-ready datasets using Power Query.
fields.objective: Connect, profile, clean, transform, integrate, and prepare multiple raw data sources using Power Query.

fields.title: Power BI Service Publishing, Sharing and Decision-Making
fields.skill_statement: Publish and share dashboards through Power BI Service for decision-making.
fields.objective: Publish, configure, validate, and share a Power BI solution through Power BI Service.

fields.title: Analytical Data Modelling, Relationships and Hierarchies
fields.skill_statement: Build data models with relationships and hierarchies in Power BI.
fields.objective: Design and implement a robust Power BI analytical data model using fact and dimension tables, relationships, cardinality, hierarchies, and role-playing date scenarios.

fields.title: DAX Measures and Analytical Calculations
fields.skill_statement: Apply DAX to create measures and calculated columns for analytical calculations.
fields.objective: Create an accurate and efficient DAX calculation layer for advanced business analysis.

fields.title: Informative Reports and Interactive Executive Dashboard
fields.skill_statement: Design informative reports and interactive dashboards to visualize key metrics.
fields.objective: Develop professional multi-page reports and an interactive executive dashboard.

fields.title: Data Integration and Transformation Using Power Query - Proficient
fields.instructions: Use the uploaded Basic assignment document as the authoritative task and rubric source.
tasks: Connect to the provided Sales, Product, and Store data files.
Profile the datasets and identify data quality issues.
Remove duplicate transaction records.
Handle blank and null values appropriately.
Correct incorrect data types.
Standardize inconsistent date formats.
Standardize inconsistent naming conventions.
Rename columns using meaningful and consistent names.
Split or merge columns where appropriate.
Remove unnecessary columns.
Apply appropriate basic Power Query transformations.
Load the transformed datasets into Power BI.
deliverables: Short data preparation report covering data quality issues, transformations, and rationale
fields.expected_outcome: A clean, consistent, and analysis-ready dataset that can be used for data modelling and reporting.

fields.title: DAX Measures and Analytical Calculations - Foundation
fields.instructions: Use the uploaded Basic assignment document as the authoritative task and rubric source.
tasks: Create 3-5 DAX measures such as Total Sales, Total Quantity Sold, Average Sales, Number of Transactions, and Total Profit.
Create at least one calculated column such as Profit = Sales Amount - Cost Amount.
Use basic DAX functions including SUM, AVERAGE, COUNT, and DISTINCTCOUNT.
Validate calculations against source data.
Explain the business meaning of the metrics.
deliverables: Short explanation of how metrics support decision-making
fields.expected_outcome: A set of accurate DAX measures and calculated columns that provide meaningful business metrics for analysing sales performance.

fields.title: Analytical Data Modelling, Relationships and Hierarchies - Proficient
fields.instructions: Use the uploaded Basic assignment document as the authoritative task and rubric source.
tasks: Create a Sales fact table.
Create Product, Store, and Date dimension tables.
Establish relationships between the fact and dimension tables.
Configure appropriate one-to-many cardinality.
Create a Product hierarchy with Category and Product.
Create a Date hierarchy with Year, Quarter, Month, and Date.
Organize the model clearly and logically.
Validate the model using sample data analysis.
fields.expected_outcome: A functional basic star-schema data model that enables accurate analysis of sales across products, stores, regions, and time.

fields.title: Analytical Data Modelling, Relationships and Hierarchies - Foundation
fields.instructions: Use the uploaded Basic assignment document as the authoritative task and rubric source.
tasks: Create a Sales fact table.
Create Product, Store, and Date dimension tables.
Establish relationships between the fact and dimension tables.
Configure appropriate one-to-many cardinality.
Create a Product hierarchy with Category and Product.
Create a Date hierarchy with Year, Quarter, Month, and Date.
Organize the model clearly and logically.
Validate the model using sample data analysis.
fields.expected_outcome: A functional basic star-schema data model that enables accurate analysis of sales across products, stores, regions, and time.

fields.title: Informative Reports and Interactive Executive Dashboard - Foundation
fields.instructions: Use the uploaded Basic assignment document as the authoritative task and rubric source.
tasks: Create one or two report pages showing Total Sales, Total Quantity Sold, Sales by Product Category, Sales by Store, Sales trend over time, and product or category performance.
Use suitable visuals such as cards, bar or column charts, line charts, tables, and matrices.
Create an interactive dashboard with Date, Region, Store, and Product Category slicers.
Implement basic drill-down using the Product hierarchy.
Enable interactive filtering between visuals.
Present KPIs clearly with appropriate formatting and layout.
deliverables: Screenshots of the completed report and dashboard
fields.expected_outcome: A clear, well-organized, and interactive Power BI reporting solution that enables management to understand sales performance and explore key business trends.

fields.title: Data Integration and Transformation Using Power Query - Expert
fields.instructions: Use the uploaded Advanced assignment document as the authoritative task and rubric source.
tasks: Connect to the ERP, CRM, Product, Store/Regional, Exchange Rate, and Calendar data sources.
Profile the data and identify data quality issues.
Append or combine datasets where appropriate.
Merge related datasets using appropriate keys.
Resolve mismatched keys and missing identifiers.
Handle missing and invalid records.
Remove duplicate records.
Standardize multiple date formats.
Convert text-encoded numerical values into appropriate data types.
Apply conditional transformations.
Implement currency conversion using exchange rate data.
Create reusable Power Query parameters where appropriate.
Create reusable Power Query functions where appropriate.
Produce a consistent, analysis-ready data structure.
deliverables: Data quality issues and resolution summary
fields.expected_outcome: A reliable and reusable Power Query transformation process that integrates multiple data sources and produces high-quality, analysis-ready datasets.

fields.title: Analytical Data Modelling, Relationships and Hierarchies - Expert
fields.instructions: Use the uploaded Advanced assignment document as the authoritative task and rubric source.
tasks: Build a proper star schema.
Create and configure the Sales fact table.
Create Date, Customer, Product, Store, Region, and Currency dimensions.
Establish appropriate relationships.
Configure correct cardinality.
Apply appropriate cross-filter directions.
Create Product and Date hierarchies.
Implement Order Date and Ship Date analysis.
Use USERELATIONSHIP where appropriate.
Validate the model using sample analytical scenarios.
Document the data model architecture.
fields.expected_outcome: A robust and optimized analytical data model supporting flexible analysis across customers, products, regions, stores, currencies, and multiple date perspectives.

fields.title: DAX Measures and Analytical Calculations - Expert
fields.instructions: Use the uploaded Advanced assignment document as the authoritative task and rubric source.
tasks: Create at least 8-12 DAX measures covering sales, profit, margin, quantity, average order value, time intelligence, growth, and ranking.
Use CALCULATE, FILTER, SUMX, AVERAGEX, RANKX, VAR and RETURN.
Demonstrate time-intelligence functions and filter-context modification.
Use at least one iterator function.
deliverables: DAX documentation with measure name, expression, purpose, explanation, and business use case
fields.expected_outcome: A comprehensive and accurate DAX calculation layer that supports advanced business analysis and management decision-making.

fields.title: Power BI Service Publishing, Sharing and Decision-Making - Expert
fields.instructions: Use the uploaded Advanced assignment document as the authoritative task and rubric source.
tasks: Publish the completed Power BI report to Power BI Service.
Configure an appropriate workspace.
Publish the report and semantic model or dataset.
Verify that the published report functions correctly.
Validate filters, slicers, drill-through, bookmarks, and navigation.
Demonstrate access and sharing.
Provide publication and sharing evidence.
Prepare an executive insights summary.
Provide at least three actionable business recommendations.
deliverables: Published Power BI report or dashboard
fields.expected_outcome: A successfully published and shareable Power BI analytics solution that enables business stakeholders to access insights and make informed strategic decisions.
